pre_access_guards: verify exact source SHA256 before selective value interpretation
recursively scan key names and fail closed on RESULT/PAYOUT/outcome/settlement/odds/price/economics/ROI/profit-like keys
decode only race_id plus entrant car_no/class/style/score
do not access any companion RESULT/PAYOUT/outcome/price/economics source
mechanical_checks: aggregate class/style support observation only; neither class nor style may influence SW0 utility
per-race entrant count >=3 and unique car_no
generate frozen SW0 ordered-top3 probabilities for every mechanically valid race
all emitted values finite and nonnegative
ordered-top3 probability mass sums to 1 within absolute error <=1e-10 for every race

decision_rule.PASS_SOURCE_WIDE_MECHANICAL_COMPATIBILIT: exact hash matches; forbidden-key scan clear; all 2000 races have authorized fields with valid types/no missingness; every race has >=3 unique cars; frozen SW0 generates finite nonnegative normalized top3 probabilities for all 2000 races
decision_rule.FAIL_CLOSED: any identity/hash mismatch, forbidden key, missing/invalid authorized field, duplicate/malformed race, nonfinite score or probability sanity failure; no tuning and no second rerun under this Gate

persistence_rule: Persist aggregate counts/support/probability-sanity metrics only; no real PRE row values or per-race probabilities.
